findings.title: Binding grants cluster-admin
findings.description: A RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding whose roleRef points at cluster-admin grants full cluster control to its subjects. Bind least-privilege roles instead and audit cluster-admin bindings.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
